UpdateStageName: Check KVM access and prepared VM files
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "test -x /usr/bin/qemu-system-x86_64 && test -r /dev/kvm && test -w /dev/kvm && test -s haos/haos.qcow2 && test -w haos/haos.qcow2 && test -s haos/OVMF_CODE.fd && test -s haos/OVMF_VARS.fd && test -w haos/OVMF_VARS.fd || { echo 'HAOS preflight failed: check QEMU, amp user KVM permissions, and prepared files under the instance haos directory.' >&2; exit 1; }"
